products.body_html:
The night victory became a legacy.

Drawn from the deep navy and fresh blue of the most recent campaign, 2026 captures a win that felt less like an arrival and more like confirmation. After the release of 2024, this was India returning under the weight of expectation and still playing like a team in control - defending the crown, owning the moment, and turning a great era into something larger.

The cooler palette gives the watch a cleaner, more composed energy, confidence without the need to shout. 2026 is a tribute to the night India did not just win again. It defended, repeated, and turned belief into dynasty.

2026 is a limited edition of 100 pieces only.

The night India exhaled.

Drawn from the blue and orange of modern Indian Cricket, 2024 captures the release of a victory that felt urgent, emotional, and long overdue. After years of coming close, the wait finally broke. The palette carries the energy of the era: intense, fearless, and impossible to look away from.

More than a celebration of winning, 2024 is about pressure survived, belief repaid, and a final that reminded everyone why cricket still has the power to stop time.

2024 is a limited edition of 100 pieces only.

The night the wait finally ended.

Drawn from the blue and orange of that unforgettable campaign, 2011 carries the weight of a victory that meant more because of where it happened and how long it had been coming. Every detail speaks to a night that was emotional, pressurised, and impossible to forget - a captain’s six into the Mumbai sky, a master finally lifted on the shoulders of his team. 

2011 is not just a winning year. It is the year a generation got the ending it had been dreaming of!

2011 is a limited edition of 100 pieces only.

The night we found a new kind of swagger.

Drawn from the light blue and bold yellow of that era, 2007 captures a moment that felt young, unexpected, and completely electric. This was not just a victory - it was the beginning of a new chapter: a team playing with freedom, instinct, and nerve in a format that brought a different kind of pressure and a different kind of joy. 

The bright colour accents give the watch a more playful, high-energy character. 2007 is a tribute to the win that announced a new generation: fearless, fast, and impossible to ignore.

2007 is a limited edition of 100 pieces only.

The night we first learnt to believe.

Drawn from the deep navy and crisp whites of India’s earliest victorious era, 1983 captures a moment before colour, spectacle, and superstardom fully took over the game. The restrained palette carries a vintage sporting character:  disciplined, clean, and quietly defiant.

1983 is a tribute to the underdog victory that became an origin story, the night Indian cricket stopped being hopeful and started becoming inevitable.

1983 is a limited edition of 100 pieces only.

products.title: Kaziranga Gorh
products.body_html:
Built around the slow, ancient power of the one-horned rhinoceros.

Drawn from Assam’s Riverland, tall elephant grass, and the heavy quiet of the Brahmaputra Valley, Kaziranga Gorh sits in a landscape that feels old, wet, and alive. A deep green fume dial pulls from Kaziranga’s floodplains – grass darkened by morning dew, forest edges, and river shadows. The black strap with green stitching gives it a sharper, more field-ready edge, like safari gear laid out before sunrise.

Rhino Hoof Prints move around the dial like heavy impressions in soft earth, hinting at an animal that has never needed to announce its power. Anchored to Assam through its Assamese numeral at 12 and the engraved state map on the caseback, 

Kaziranga Gorh is a tribute to endurance, conservation, and the quiet majesty of a creature that seems to belong to another age.

products.title: Jawai Tendua
products.body_html:
Built around the animal you almost never see coming.

Drawn from Rajasthan’s granite hills, scrubland and the strange calm of leopard country, Jawai Tendua sits in a landscape where wilderness slips quietly into everyday life. A Dark Grey Fume Dial takes its cue from Jawai’s stone outcrops at dusk: cool, watchful, almost still and the grey strap sharpens it with a nocturnal edge.

Leopard Paw Prints cross the dial like soft marks over rock and dust, suggesting an animal defined by stealth rather than spectacle. Anchored to Rajasthan through its Devanagari Numeral at 12 and the engraved state map on the case back, Jawai Tendua is a tribute to coexistence, camouflage, and the charged stillness of a place where the wild lives just beyond the village lights.

The most understated watch in the collection because in Jawai, the most powerful presence is often the one you almost miss.

products.title: Gir Sinh
products.body_html:
Drawn from Gujarat’s dry teak forests, thorn scrub and sun-baked trails, Gir Sinh sits in a landscape that feels rugged, open, and quietly powerful. A Warm Brown Fume Dial pulls from Gir’s earth, bark and late-afternoon light, while the brown strap carries the dusty practicality of the forest road.

Lion Paw Prints move around the dial like heavy marks pressed into dry ground: unhurried, unhidden, and certain.

 

Anchored to Gujarat through its Gujarati Numeral at 12 and the engraved state map on the case back, Gir Sinh is a tribute to survival, pride, and the calm confidence of a creature that has never needed to chase attention.

products.title: Ranthambore Bagh
products.body_html:
Built around the silence before the sighting.

Drawn from Rajasthan’s dry forests, weathered stone forts and the held breath of tiger country, Ranthambore Bagh lives in a landscape where nothing announces itself too early.

A Muted Olive Dial takes its cue from dhok scrub and shadowed trails. The Earthy Brown Strap brings in the dust, bark and trail-worn character of the terrain.

Tiger Paw Prints circle the dial like signs left on a morning track, hinting at presence rather than revealing it outright. Anchored to Rajasthan through its Devanagari Numeral at 12 and the engraved state map on the case back, Ranthambore Bagh is a tribute to patience, instinct, and that rare moment when the forest suddenly comes alive.

products.title: Rain Check
products.body_html:
Nobody’s stepping out for this one.

The most unhurried expression of the Arka collection: a Rich Green Sunray Dial drawn from a monsoon afternoon, when the garden turns impossibly green and the rain is in no rush to clear. Warm Copper-Toned Bregnagari Numerals sit softly against the green, while the Konark Wheel Small Seconds turns at its own easy pace.

A Dark Brown Alligator Textured Calf Leather Strap with subtle stitching keeps it warm, distinctive, and unbothered: made for a good book, a seat by the window, and nowhere else to be.

It is not a day lost to the rain.

It is a day reclaimed by it.

products.title: White Noise
products.body_html:
The calm of something steady, constant, and quietly always there.

The most understated expression of the Arka collection is an Ivory Sunray Dial built around a steady, unbroken calm, the visual equivalent of a hum you stop noticing because it never leaves. Black Bregnagari Numerals create a quiet contrast, while a small Black Konark Wheel Small Seconds hand adds depth and rhythm to the dial.

A Black Alligator Textured Calf Leather Strap keeps it clean, versatile, and quietly distinctive: a modern Indian dress watch built for the background of every day, not just its highlights.

It is not the loudest color in the room.
It is the one that's always been right.

products.title: After Hours
products.body_html:
For the hours after the day is officially done, when the city slows but the night is still young.

The nocturnal expression of the Arka collection: a deep navy sunray dial drawn from the sky after dark, when the schedule ends but the evening doesn't. Warm Ivory Bregnagari Numerals stand crisp against the blue, while the Konark Wheel Small Seconds gives the watch a quiet, continuous rhythm.

A Black Alligator Textured Calf Leather Strap makes it sharp, cinematic, and easy to dress up: made for dinners that run long, conversations that don't need to end, and the hours that belong to no one but you.

It is not the end of the day.
It is the part that was always off the clock.

products.title: Golden Hour
products.body_html:
The hour when the day turns warm, soft, and golden.

The most radiant expression of the Arka collection is a warm Salmon Sunray Dial drawn from evening light as it falls across stone, skin, and sky. Deep Blue Bregnagari Numerals bring a crisp contrast to the dial, while the Konark Wheel Small Seconds adds a quiet pulse to the composition.

A Dark Brown Alligator Textured Calf Leather Strap keeps it elegant but not formal, warm but not loud, made for golden hours, long evenings, and moments that deserve to stretch a little longer.

It is not just the colour of the sunset.
It is the glow before the day lets go.

products.title: Cloud Nine
products.body_html:
The feeling of being exactly where you want to be.

The airiest expression of the Arka collection: a powder blue sunray dial that feels like morning skies and good moods, drawn from the softest hour of the day. Deep Blue Bregnagari Numerals lend it contrast and character, while the Konark Wheel at 6 o'clock brings a gentle, turning rhythm to the dial.

A Navy Blue Alligator Textured Calf Leather Strap with subtle Blue Stitching keeps it light, easy, and quietly joyful, a dress watch that feels like a good day ahead.

It is not about staying grounded.
It is about floating a little higher.
